reviews.name: Carmella R.
reviews.summary: Appreciated help with permits and HOA, a prompt estimate, fast scheduling, and clear communication. Described a straightforward process and a finished deck she was happy with.

reviews.name: Margarita M.
reviews.summary: Pleased with a composite deck in Frankfort. Praised Peter’s guidance, the crew’s respectful approach, and a sturdy finished deck with low maintenance needs.

reviews.name: Chris B.
reviews.summary: Praised the workmanship and respectful crew after a new privacy fence was completed in two days.

reviews.name: Vadym
reviews.summary: Described an on-time appointment with William, clear answers, and an organized build managed by Andrew. Happy with the wooden deck, communication, and the team’s approach.

reviews.name: Chris M
reviews.summary: Happy with a replacement composite deck and added roof. Found the project manager easy to work with and planned to return for a privacy fence.

reviews.name: Patricia G
reviews.summary: Described an easy experience, little stress, and a finished job she was pleased with.

reviews.name: Oranette B
reviews.summary: Praised William’s explanation of siding choices and Andrew’s organized crew. Highlighted daily cleanup, communication, fair pricing, and a neat exterior finish.

reviews.name: Jamal c
reviews.summary: Appreciated a redesigned deck layout, material guidance, and a better stair location. Praised Andrew’s updates, daily cleanup, solid framing, and sturdy railings, including how small changes during construction were handled.

reviews.name: Marta G.
reviews.summary: Pleased with a full kitchen remodel. Described Peter as responsive and professional and highlighted the quality, schedule, and a finished kitchen that matched her plans.

reviews.name: Siarhei M.
reviews.summary: Praised Peter’s help choosing a layout and materials within budget. Appreciated Andrew’s careful construction, the detailed tile and fixture work, daily tidiness, and an on-schedule finish.

reviews.name: Allen
reviews.summary: Praised punctuality, attention to detail, and clear communication from consultation through walkthrough. Described solid craftsmanship, clean finishing, and a renovation that transformed the space.
